verbatim_excerpt: All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution. If a section lists an R4 District, therefore, the provisions of that section shall also apply to R4-1, R4A and R4B Districts, unless separate provisions for the districts with suffixes are listed within such section. Wherever a section lists only a district with a suffix, the provisions applicable to such district are different from the provisions of that district without a suffix. If a section lists only a C4-6A District, therefore, the provisions of that section are not applicable to a C4-6 District.
notes: This is the Resolution's own general suffix-inheritance rule (last amended 6/29/1994, predates City of Yes). It is used by D-049 (owner decision, 2026-09-13) as the basis for treating ZR 23-421's bare 'R1'/'R2' district labels as extending the same 25 ft perimeter-wall / 35 ft ridge pitched-roof envelope to R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2A, and R2X - NONE of which 23-421's own opening enumeration line names.

PROVENANCE DISCIPLINE (M4-T012 / D-049-R001): every rule that cites this snapshot to extend a numeric constraint to a district symbol 23-421 does not itself name MUST carry an explicit OWNER-DECISION provenance marker and MUST NOT present that extension as an express per-variant citation of 23-421. Bare 'R1' and 'R2' (which 23-421 DOES name directly) are encoded from the express enumeration and do not need this snapshot.

The professional-confirmation ask (whether this section's 'except as otherwise set forth in express provisions' caveat is fully accounted for by the modifiers the owner's research identified - 23-421(g), 23-424, 23-425, 23-426(a), 23-443(b), 119-212, 113-523) REMAINS OPEN at docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md (A1/A3) pending G6.
